Used for: factory-tuned ST7789VI init values (porch, gate, VCOM, power, gamma, inversion)
in platform/stm32h743/ (adapted from 8-bit bit-banged AVR to 16-bit 8080 on the FMC,
COLMOD 0x55 = 65K colours, 16 bpp, one bus write per pixel).
